side.description: Turn existing C# source code into a Markdown documentation set with call chains, so humans can understand what the code does.
side.cfg.language.desc: Language of the generated documents and AI descriptions.
side.cfg.baseUrl.desc: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Works with OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, local Ollama, OpenCode Go, and others.
side.cfg.model.desc: Model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-chat, or qwen2.5-coder:7b.
side.cfg.docsDir.desc: Output folder for the generated documents, relative to the workspace root.
